rules.governor: Same state, Governor only, 2018–2024; keep one event for each state/year. No 2014 historical error.
rules.federal: Senate & President same-state only for general federal correction. Alaska House candidate-repeat context remains separately flagged legacy evidence.
rules.house: Excluded from statewide historical calibration; Cook, other published ratings, and attributed House polls are separate evidence.
rules.duplicate: One selected historical governor aggregate per state-year; never double count 538/270toWin/RCP variants of the same contest. Identical current survey fingerprints flagged for review, not silently removed.
